en.headline: Driver missing after private car hits railings in Sau Mau Ping
en.dek: Police found an empty white private car with a damaged front end at On Sau Road and On Kin Road shortly after 5am and are trying to contact the owner.
body: A white private car struck railings at a pedestrian crossing in Sau Mau Ping early on Sunday, and officers who arrived found nobody inside the vehicle.

The incident was reported at about 5.08am. Police said the car was travelling along On Sau Road when it appeared to lose control as it turned into On Kin Road, hitting metal railings in the middle of the road. The front end and bumper were damaged.

Passers-by alerted police. Officers found the cabin empty and said they were using available records to contact the registered owner. The cause of the crash and the driver's whereabouts were under investigation.

zh.headline: 秀茂坪私家車撞欄司機不知所終
zh.dek: 周日清晨一輛白色私家車在安秀道轉入安健道時撞向路中鐵欄，警員到場發現車內無人，正聯絡車主。
body: 秀茂坪周日清晨發生交通意外，一輛白色私家車撞向行人過路處鐵欄後停下，警員到場時車內空無一人。
事發約早上5時08分。警方表示，車輛沿安秀道駮至轉入安健道時懷疑失控，撞向路中鐵欄，車頭及泵把損毀。
途人報案後，警員根據車輛資料聯絡車主協助調查，意外原因及司機下落仍在跟進。
